items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: I'd book him and he had his first record on him... I'd just drop him.

ctx.x: And the same picture with Johnny? Yeah. That Linda Jones, she died at the Faller Theater. She was at Diabetics. Did you ever have any dealings with your power? Yeah, Ernie Tone was there, Chris Kenner was there, and, uh. I know Slim used to play that with you. I don't remember what it was, but Slim played that I didn't have, Shawhead. Shawhead. Shawhead. That's the only time I had that at the Faller Theater. Ernie played the Faller and the Howard and the Rigg in Chicago on the same tour she did. She had a week at…
I thought, what if it's still...
